resources.string: Point your phone camera at the QR code and type on the page that opens.
The TV is not connected to a network
Type and search from your phone
1. Put the phone and the TV on the same Wi-Fi.
2. Point the phone camera at the QR code.
3. Type on the page that opens: search YouTube or fill a field on the TV.
4. Bookmark the page — next time you won\'t need the QR code.
If it won\'t open: phone Settings → Apps → Chrome → Permissions → Nearby devices → Allow
Type on the phone and press \"Send to TV\". With the remote: OK, type, then the magnifier key on the right.
No text field is open on the TV — use Search YouTube
Can\'t reach the TV. Are the phone and the TV on the same Wi-Fi?
Scan the QR code on the TV again: Settings → Phone.
